test_title: PYST 67: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Read the following statements carefully and choose the correct option regarding Assertion (A) and Reason (R).

Assertion (A): Devaluation of the rupee in 1991 improved export competitiveness.

Reason (R): A weaker rupee made Indian goods cheaper in global markets.

options.text: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Devaluation** refers to the deliberate downward adjustment of a country's currency value relative to other currencies.
 
• In 1991, India faced a severe balance of payments crisis, leading to the devaluation of the Indian rupee to improve economic stability and export competitiveness.
 
• The devaluation made Indian goods cheaper in international markets, boosting demand and export volumes.
 
• A weaker rupee reduced the cost of Indian products relative to foreign goods, thus increasing global trade opportunities.
 
• This policy helped India earn foreign exchange and stabilize the economy during the crisis period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A**

 
 
• This option is incorrect because the Reason (R) directly explains why the Assertion (A) is true. The devaluation of the rupee indeed made Indian goods cheaper in global markets, and this was the primary factor behind improved export competitiveness.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A is true but R is false**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because both the Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true. The devaluation directly influenced export competitiveness by making Indian goods cheaper internationally.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: A is false but R is true**
 
 
• This option is incorrect as the Assertion (A) is true. The devaluation of the rupee in 1991 was a significant step toward improving export competitiveness.
 
• Additionally, the Reason (R) is true because a weaker rupee naturally makes goods more affordable in foreign markets.
